items.description: Electrician labour to check and rewire flooded circuits
items.rationale: Surface rainwater is flood under §2.5, not escape of water, and no schedule entry for group (c2) is shown. Section 3.6 bars the labour on the supplied record; if covered, 12 hours at €105 gross would total €1,260.
Section 3.6.2(f) bars journey charges for the uncovered flood. If group (c2) were confirmed, this is the first listed journey and would be priced at 1 × €79 under §7.1.7(g).

Section 3.6 bars the flood claim, and §§4.3(d) and 5.2.2 independently exclude separate payment for pump procurement alongside the extraction measure. The positive estimate is a notional gross charge for one procurement line.

Section 3.6 bars the flood claim, and §5.2.2 includes temporary pump use in the extraction measure rather than paying it separately. The positive estimate is a notional gross charge for one pump deployment.
Section 5.2.2 would cover extraction as one measure inclusive of labour and equipment, estimated at €750 gross. It is barred by §3.6 because flood cover under group (c2) is not shown.
Section 3.6.2(c) bars materials for the uncovered flood. If covered, §7.1.7(c) would allow one lot of comparable materials actually installed, estimated at €180 gross.

items.description: Boiler system renewal with flue and storage tank
items.rationale: Fixed plant is insured property, but §3.6 bars its replacement where flood cover is not shown. Under §7.1.1(c), the conditional estimate is €12,500 gross for one installed equivalent residential boiler system, including flue and tank.
Section 3.6.2(a) bars adaptation work for the uncovered flood. If covered, §7.1.7(d) would allow one necessary adaptation of the immediately adjoining supply pipework, estimated at €950 gross.
Section 3.6.2(e) bars removal and disposal for the uncovered flood. If covered, §5.2.1 would allow one system removal and disposal charge, estimated at €650 gross.

Section 3.6.2(f) bars journey charges, and §7.1.8(d) would independently exclude this second listed journey even if flood cover were confirmed. The conditional benchmark for one eligible journey is €79 gross.
